lore.title: Galetry
lore.intro: Galetry is A peaceful gallery resting between the mountain tops. Eager to collect your scrap and deliver it to the company building.

secs.html: These logs can be found around Galetry. In order, The Collector can be found on the Hoarding Bug bust to the right of the Log translator, Company trouble can be found on the ground to the left of the counter, Intruder can be found on the ground past the fire exit door, and The great mystery can be found in the backstage area on some boxes near the secure door. Dread can be found in the room past the secure door.

Text ⁠
I cannot say I am much of a writer, I beg of you, don’t have grave expectations.
As for any story it would be good to know who’s behind the pencil. Or keyboard in this instance.

To introduce myself, my name is Zellenah. Born on Haltar under the family name Cross.
For those who are unaware, Haltar is likely one of the wealthiest moons still remaining in our region.
First, an agreement. Then the golden flame. Foolish to have gotten involved.
Our father couldn’t keep the political talk to himself so I’ve become rather educated on the conflict.

I feel I am already losing the path. Where was I? Ah yes.
For the greater part of my life I have spent mindlessly staring at golden halls and sipping the most elegant vintages while relatives endlessly discuss their fortunes with a devotion I could not understand. We’ve always gone on the same trips and visited the same fountains. I couldn’t convey how often I’ve seen the gemstone waters.
You could say I’ve always had more of an explorative trait. The predictability of it all became rather stifling. The people are kind, but perhaps a touch soulless. All they conversed about was their wealth and what grandiose places they visited. I found it to be rather dull. Terribly underwhelming. I fear the normality of it all has greatly impacted my joy of what were seemingly magnificent things.

I found myself unwilling to accept such predictability so I left for a few trips outside of our usual experiences.
A majority of the places I went to were fresh, unique. Often whelming as I had witnessed the same before but on a grander scale.

Then, during one of these visits there were these magnetized pebbles. Not too extraordinary I believe we have all seen magnets before. But these pebbles, when they touched they would brighten up. Not only brighten up, they would share a light that traveled between them. Now that was lovely. I had never seen that before. Truly magnificent. I still have them somewhere I am quite certain. Perhaps in one of my drawers with the crystals which pacifies insects with a soft drone, another magical find.
Either way I put on a glove and took a hand full of them back to the manor.
From then on all I ever wanted was to collect more of these interesting objects.
Indeed I did. I went on many trips following this initial find.
I had gathered plentiful mistiques. It had gotten to a point where they were turning my manors into a dreadful mess.
There was a terrible need for a place to put these things. And that’s when I came with the idea of the gallery. A gallery of uniquities.
I wouldn’t want it to be back on Haltar, you could display something magnificent and they wouldn’t even lift their glasses.

This place looks delightful and happens to be right in the center of everything. Nearly too good to be true.
So I acquired this small moon and began planning out the gallery.
A few months pass and now we are here.

I appreciate your reading. I find it incredibly relaxing to write.
Perhaps I might write some more in the future.

Text ⁠
I desire to write again following today's frightful ordeal.
It was in the early morning when the trouble began. I had woken up from an annoyingly repetitive beeping coming from my computer. And so I had a gaze at what happened to be a message. It was deeply unsettling.
It read as follows: 
“The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”.
Of course I took this sudden message very dear. It had appeared to be rather important though a bit distasteful. So as with any message of seemingly grave importance like this I had informed them, in terms perhaps less diplomatic than advisable, that I had no interest in their proposal.

Not much time had passed and I heard this charming jingle of an elevator of sorts followed by an explosion. Immediately I put on my gloves and armed myself with an antique blade in hopes it would scare away whoever had impolitely seared my front yard. Or at the very least offer me the confidence to confront them.

To my surprise there was nobody there. Only the wind, a dull quietness and a pod with a big gap presumably from the explosion.
Then to my surprise, a dreadful swarm of hornets attacked me. I ran away as fast as I could and locked myself in my bed chamber.
Then I remembered those droning crystals. Unsure where I had left them I began searching. It had taken me a fair moment but in the end I discovered them to be in a small box in one of my closets. I took out a few and slowly opened the door. Nothing in the hallway. Quite curious. I slowly made my way along the gallery towards the entrance, not a hornet in sight. Then to my surprise there was a bulging man standing in the grass. He quietly gazed at me. To my knowledge I was alone, there hadn’t been any visitors in days. I yelled out to him. No response. Frightening. I took a step back. Then he seemed to search for something in his tailor coat. Before long he ran at me holding a shimmering knife. Having neither a plan or any courage in that moment I instinctively held out the small bag of crystals between us. To my surprise this bloated man seemed enamored by them. Staring soullessly into the bag. Only then it dawned on me, this was not an ordinary man at all, but a deteriorating arrangement of skin and cloth piloted by these hornets. The dreadful smell only confirmed that. Terrifying discovery yet I must admit in a way quite divine.
I had led him to the back room as he followed the bag of crystals. As I had no proper placement for this ominous gentleman, I elected to leave him where he was. I don’t think he minds that much.

Finally I return to my computer only to find it beeping once more. A new message.
“You have received your first and only warning, The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”
I was left with a choice and perhaps in an act of fear I agreed.

As long as I help their workers ship the things they found to Gordion without interrupting their work, I should be left alone.
I’m hopeful.

Text ⁠
There has been a fair passage of time between now and the previous time I have written.
I had not expected this arrangement would prove so demanding. It feels as though every few days a new ship arrives at my door, not to be enamored by the mystiques of my gallery but rather to dispose of the debris they have gathered.
I have attempted to inquire about their work yet they seem either hesitant to explain or convey that they know as much as I do.
Either way, I have made the wise decision to automate the process of exporting these worthless pieces to Gordion. I cannot imagine taking care of such matters personally without leaving me exhausted.

There has however been one thing I became aware of regarding this mysterious company. They do not take kindly to their employees and demand them work an absurd amount where failure appears to be met with termination in the quite literal sense.
I have always been aware of the cruelty within this region from the tales but I had never imagined it to be this terrible. Not until I met this gentleman of the name Marcus Brad.

I wouldn't say it was the most pleasant of encounters.
This company ship had landed and were doing their own usual business. I on the other hand was altering some of the displays, not quite paying the attention to my surroundings as I likely should have.
Upon turning, I discovered an armed stranger silently standing a few paces behind me, which in honesty I found considerably less pleasant than the display I had been arranging moments earlier. It was quite alarming even and my response was rather lacking. He demanded that I help him with his harrowing situation which, at the time, I wasn’t aware of how bad it was. His suit appeared worn, bloodied with a scorch mark covering the left side of his helmet. An intimidating figure.
I exclaimed I wouldn’t know how and even if I did there would be a chance this mysterious company would return with evil intent.
He appeared serious, slightly frustrated even. Still pointing the weapon in my direction I attempted to politely ask for his name and how I could be of service.
“My name is Marcus.”, he replied. “I have survived this company for at least five weeks now. You wouldn’t believe what they put us through. You need to help me escape them. Sooner or later they will try to kill me again.”. This ominous response left me curious and so I tried to inquire what exactly he meant with, they will try to kill him again. He replied: “We have a quota we have to meet every few days. It keeps getting higher every time we succeed. I don’t believe it stops. It gets higher and higher until it’s impossible to reach. What happens if we don’t meet the quota? We die. The ship enters space and opens the doors sucking us into space to die an excruciating death. I survived this once, only because I could crawl into this airtight space within the ship’s internals before the doors opened and.. Took the others.”.
I was stunned by this news. I confess I initially expected exaggeration.
I could now sense that it wasn’t frustration in his voice but desperation. Perhaps a hint of sadness and dread.
I offered a proposal, if he’s able to find and bring me uniquities or antiquities. I would search for a way of hiding him from and possibly tricking this company. Which he accepted.

Since that eye opening encounter I have had a security system installed at the counter in case somebody deranged comes upon me with malicious intent.
So it appears for now I will be keeping myself busy with devising a plan alongside some other research I have been doing.
I am certain I will write again.

Text ⁠
I must write about this. I believe I have acquired all the information that remains.
Back in my early days on Haltar, on the television this advertisement would play. It was an elegant place to visit with stunning environments, yet I’ve never quite discovered where this place is or even what it’s called. I only remember greenery with purplish waters and a soft pink sky. It was extraordinary. But it seems as if it never existed, though I am certain it did.
Throughout my life I have attempted to inquire information of its whereabouts yet nobody seemed to know. I only had rumors to work off of. Some said it was made to disappear due to a chemical accident. Others said it was a hoax entirely, which seemed like a rather dull explanation.

I simply cannot allow the matter to remain unsolved. It has most certainly been removed form every public source of information as nothing has turned up over the many years I have searched for this. But perhaps a physical copy remains in existence somewhere.

I have reached what may generously be described as a plan, the idea fills me with discomfort, though I see no alternative but to attend to it personally. When Marcus returns I will fly out with him in search of what could be one of the only physical copies of this remarkable advertisement. I believe I know where such a copy may still exist.
You will see me return soon.

Text ⁠
I am uncertain where to begin.
What has occurred was beyond dreadful.
I find myself lacking the vocabulary to describe it.
It has taken me a fair amount of time to even build the courage to leave my bed chamber.
I am frightened. Deeply frightened. It was a mistake. They died because I ran. I watched him cry in fear as I fled like a coward.
These doors will protect me. Opening them would require a considerable source of power. Such sources are rare in today’s day and age. Yet still I fear. There is a sound. I was certain it was my imagination playing tricks on me. I no longer believe that.
It’s drawing nearer. Every day I become more certain of that.
It spoke. I wish it had not. It echoes through my mind. It leaves me without peace.
It’s drawing nearer.
I should never have viewed that tape.
I assure you what I am hearing is real.
That thing was real.
I urge you to stay away. I beg of you.
Let it remain undisturbed.

lore.title: Gratar
lore.intro: Gratar was known for housing the biggest factory in the solar system. The whole facility was controlled by an AI made by a fantastic inventor last seen on Etern. As of recent, legend has it that the AI on Gratar has gone rogue.

secs.html: G. A. R. Y., the AI, was originally created by the scientist on Etern with the intention of finding the location of Cosmocos after it teleported. However, the AI was incapable of reciting the full location, either because the location was encrypted or because the AI was malfunctioning. It then got sold to be used by the company located on Gratar.

lore.title: Hyve
lore.intro: Hyve/Asteroid-14 is home to the largest bee colonies in the region. Many companies have attempted to harvest honey from the massive beehives here. The locals however were not fond of intruders.

lore.title: Hyx
lore.intro: Hyx has been consumed. Do not under any circumstance go here. It is watching. It will not rest until it's done. Never. Go. Here.

secs.html: Hyx was originally advertised as a vacation destination to experience the wonders of nature. It has since been entirely "assimilated" by The Overseer, a cosmic entity and the primary antagonist of Wesley's Moons.

These logs can be found by interacting with five Databoxes on the exterior. In order of the log number, these can be found at the main entrance, at the fire exit southeast of the ship, at the fire exit north and slightly west of the ship in the forest, southwest of the ship in the forest near one of the fire exits, and northeast of the ship near a lake. They document the full timeline of the moon's assimilation.

The Beginning - 0 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
In the town of Rosemaw, a small hike into the forest a meteor fragment had impacted.
It is not unusual for small fragments to reach the surface and make contact so it wasn’t immediately reported by the public.

A few days later a few hikers had noticed an unusual looking fungus but chose to leave it be. These hikers only began to take notice once it started spreading and growing over a small patch in the forest. They didn’t think much of it and avoided the area for the time being.

The Employee - 4 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
Richard Pollar, more commonly known as Rich, arrived at the local bakery for work an hour before opening time. He started preparing the kitchen for the day, organising and cleaning the kitchen when he noticed red blobs of an unusual liquid sticking to the equipment and the furniture.
The liquid was thick and lukewarm to the touch, a gooey substance. Rich was both intrigued and disgusted by the discovery and went looking for the source. He couldn’t find anything else out of the ordinary until he got to the stove. He was frightened by what he saw. It was a rat covered in tendrils with strange goop oozing from one of its empty eyesockets, bubbling and twitching as it did. Before Rich could fully understand what he was looking at, it scurried away, fleeing to someplace outside.
He was shaking and frantically called his employer before loosely explaining what happened.
Rich was quickly dismissed with the assumption of it being another one of his psychotic breaks.
Meaning to prove that what he witnessed was real, he went to chase it down, leaving a note for the other employees explaining where he went.
Rich followed the trail of goop through the town, into the forest all the way to the area where the fungus was spotted by hikers before. There he found it, laying still on this yellow-orangish rock. Rich was bemused and stared at it for a while. He assumed it was dead considering its state and the fact it wasn’t moving anymore. The only movement he saw were these small tendrils sticking out of its body.
Unsure of what to make of it he decided to investigate, he was scared but his curiosity carried him forward. The fungus he had heard about has seemingly spread through a significant chunk of the forest.
As Rich wandered through the infested area, he laid eyes upon more of these critters in a similar condition. Witnessing this he got scared and ran back towards the bakery and told his coworkers, who had arrived by this time, what he had seen. To ensure they would believe him he had taken some pictures to show.
The coworkers seemed very concerned upon being shown the pictures. Similarly confused and disgusted they decided to investigate on their own, leaving Rich at the bakery, who at this time was still shaking.
An hour passed and Rich grew concerned, maybe they got lost, maybe they were still investigating, who knows. But he grew more and more concerned by the minute. Another hour later he finally made the decision to call the authorities. Fearing they’d dismiss him if he spoke the truth, he only said there was an emergency at the bakery. And there he stayed until an officer arrived.

An officer by the name of Michael Benson, Mike for short. Arrived at the scene finding a distressed Richard sitting in the bakery. Mike asked about the emergency to which Rich tried to explain that his coworkers left to investigate something in the forest but hadn’t returned for hours. Mike grew suspicious and calmly asked why he’s as distressed as he is. Rich told Mike there’s horrifying things happening in the forest around the infested area.
Mike called this in and went to have a look for himself, unsure if he was telling the truth. But only after a few more officers arrived at the scene.
Mike arrived at the forest and cautiously took a few steps in when he already began to see signs of something being off.
The ground was covered in yellowish rock with this red substance oozing out of the ground. Slightly deeper into the forest, plants seemed to turn gray, die or get covered in this same yellow rock.
Mike returned to the edge of the forest and called for a search party. This has to be reported, it has become a real anomaly he thought. Half an hour later four more officers arrived and the search started.
As Mike ventured deeper into the forest he began to see the same things Rich had described, Critters, seemingly deceased with tendrils erupting from their bodies. Starting to get a notion of dread he continued. As he stumbled further into the woods it became less and less lively.
Then he noticed something red, moving away from him, sliding across the rocky ground, leaving a trail of that same red substance. As Mike got closer the picture got clearer, it was similar to the critters he had seen earlier. When he walked in a big circle to the front of it he saw what it really was.
It was the front half of a moose, a large tentacle slid out of its mouth alongside a significant amount of red ooze. Where its back half was meant to be was nothing but tendrils and intestine slowly moving it forward.
Frightened, Mike quickly stepped back. He wasn’t sure what to do. It looked like it was trying to scream or yell but no sound erupted from its mouth. Another tentacle protruded through one of its eyes, pushing it out of its socket followed by blood and ooze.
Now horrified, Mike grabbed the weapon out of his holster and fired a bullet into its head, meaning to end its suffering.
It ceased to move for a moment but quickly got back to it, now oozing from the wound.
Mike was filled with dread and ran away from there. On his way back he found something else.
The missing employees laid there, lifeless on the hard rock surface. He called it in and told the other officers to head back. The employees were in a terrible condition, it looked like their limbs had torn themselves from their bodies, oozing out of their eyes and mouths. Witnessing this he ran back immediately and met up with the other officers in the bakery. This has quickly turned into a seemingly deadly fungal invasion.

The I.T.D.A. - 7 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
The town has been evacuated and all survivors involved have been brought in for questioning and isolation. The I.T.D.A. Has labeled this situation as critical and has begun quarantining the area. Nobody was allowed to enter or leave the quarantine zone. The military had been called in for additional security.
Several teams of experienced biologists and scientists had made it to the site to analyze and halt the anomalous threat. It was immediately proven not to be any sort of fungi but something else that had yet to be documented. This spread seemed to overtake whatever they put in front of it, consuming it entirely. Attempts of halting the spread were made such as burning it which only temporarily made the tendrils disappear. They had attempted several other chemical solutions to no avail. The closest they had gotten was by using a liquid which super freezes anything it comes into contact with. It only significantly slowed it down.
From this point several nearby towns were also evacuated as the spread and the quarantine area grew. Slowly but surely the area was becoming a wasteland.
It was discovered that direct contact with the substance could result in an infection which ends in a grueling eruption of tendrils, torn limbs and death.
The I.T.D.A. had officially labeled the spread as a world-ending level hazard. And as there have been no viable methods to halt the spreading or cure anyone infected. The I.T.D.A after a discussion with the Council of Rule on Calist, had marked Hyxellia as a moon in quarantine. Nobody could enter. Nobody could leave. Those who tried were either stopped or killed.
The population remaining on Hyxellia were scared, unable to send out or receive communication from a source outside of the moon, the only source they had were the I.T.D.A. which assured the public that the threat will be dealt with.
Biologists had well documented the workings of this spread which has gained the name “The Red Death”. In a detailed report it was documented how the red death consumed and spread:
The yellow rock-like material isn’t technically stone as many assumed but more similar to a very thick, dense, solidified skin. Instead of being stretchy, the density makes it much harder and rock-like. Below the yellow crust is a much softer meat-like material, this material is able to retract or expand, even move as if it’s one large living being organising its fleshy layer. This soft layer has seen to form these tentacles or tendrils for either defensive or even offensive measures. The spread itself is quite unique, these cells will attempt to eat whatever is around them and immediately replace the consumed material with a new cell. The process of consumption also generates this red substance. Drilling procedures have noted that deep inside the soft layer there’s large tunnels where the substance flows similar to our veins. The substance which gets generated doesn’t always end up within these veins, it often surfaces and forms large bubbles of goop below the crust, sometimes bursting through, leaving holes within the crust and forming large puddles of goop.
At the two week mark, the Red Death had consumed nearly half the moon. The cause seemed lost. This was the end times. Anyone still on Hyxellia was awaiting a horrible fate with no way of saving them.
Many military personnel as well as teams sent in by the I.T.D.A. have chosen to end their own lives to avoid a worse end.

lore.title: Infernis
lore.intro: Infernis was previously used for the mining of crystals and other various materials. But due to the increase of volcanic activity all sorts of insects infiltrated the facilities to seek refuge. Every employee within the building at this time was either devoured or cooked by the extreme heat.

lore.title: Polarus
lore.intro: Polarus houses the legendary Polar Vaults. These vaults contained very valuable riches before the corporation went bankrupt. The corporation was known for their extremely high hiring rates. It also appears that many of these employees magically dissapeared after being fired.

secs.html:
The log can be found following the trail of reflectors in the canyons that are in front of the ship.

Captains Log. Log 4. Location, Polarus.

First, my findings on Gratar.
We managed to trick that conniving AI into revealing the final letter to us.
It’s P.
It’s a capital P.
It’s smart - but we were smarter.
The ones of us that survived, anyway.
I think it realised we were deceiving it and it decimated 10 of us.
We’re down to a pathetic team of 8, half of whom are too disturbed to carry on their duties as usual.

Our ‘skeleton crew’ might be real skeletons, soon enough.
But I only need them to help pilot the ship for the last leg of our journey.

Because I’ve found it.
I know where Cosmocos is.

...I wonder if it felt the same loss that I felt...when I left?
Like my heart was wrenched from my chest.
To get to know something...some- someone... so magnificent...to know that you leave them blighted...wounded and sick...

I’ll be with you soon, old friend.
I’ll heal you.
I only need the opportunity.
And then we’ll be one again.

Cunningham. Signing off.

lore.title: Repress
lore.intro: The abandoned company shipyard.

secs.html: Kind crew, Insanity, and Destiny all can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They tell the story of a crew looking to escape from the company using a ship on Repress and flying to a moon in a different region known as 495-Risk. One of the crew members died to a Masked on Rend. The fate of the remaining crew is unknown.

Text ⁠
-9th of July 2349-
I found a couple floppy discs in a cabinet somewhere in the building.
Allows me to put down my thoughts using the big computer in the hangar.

First I'll introduce myself, hi, I'm Dan. It's been 7 days since I started working for the company.
Lucky for me I was greeted by a set of kind faces. They sort of explained to me how things work around here.
We're a crew of 4, there's Berry, he's pretty funny and good at keeping our spirits up. Then there's Kate who has been here the longest, used to be a mechanic for a failed business.
And there's Arnold. Big guy, pretty smart as well, we call him engine man cause he's always the one carrying the engines hehe.
(I'm also fairly certain Kate and Arnold have a thing for each other)
Don't tell them I wrote that, they'll kill me

It's been rough. We've been going from building to building day by day delivering all our Junk to the company building.
Can't say I'm quite fond of the place. The company desk reeks, it's nasty. And not only that but the building itself is quite imposing.
I don't understand why but it feels like it wants to crush me like I'm an ant in the kitchen.

Same with this place, though I feel a bit more safe here, its less menacing. Less like I'm being watched constantly.
I'm not the only one who feels that way.
Arnold hates the company building too. He's always said there's something off about it.
Maybe he's on to something.

Either way Kate just radioed in that it's getting late. I better get going.
I'll write more when I can.

Text ⁠
-12th of July 2349-
Okay where do I start. First of all. There have been several near death experiences.
The quota is starting to get dangerously high. And Berry has seemingly cought the flu.

It's been rough.

Last thing we expected was to enter an insane asylum back on Vow. I don't think I ever want to go back there.
Berry stayed for ship duty this time due him getting sick. So me, Kate and Arnold went in. The place looked haunted.
It might as well have been because I swear I saw a trash can move. Arnold also claims to have seen a dark figure briefly staring at him when he opened a door before it vanished.
Terrifying.
That wasn't the strangest part though. We heart Kate scream a few hallways down.. and when we got there, Blood was still freshly dripping from the ceiling. Guts, pieces of skin and hair littered the floor.
We were horrified. We thought it was maybe a mine or.. something worse. Either way we were in shock.
Too scared to continue we retreated back to the entrance. But when we got there, there she was completely fine carrying a hairdryer and rubik's cube.
Arnold immediately ran over. Which I guess confirms my little theory heh.
Nevertheless it was unusual to say the least. I'm going to have nightmares about that for a while.

But then I knew one thing for certain. I want to leave.
They felt the same way.
The ship would only route to a few company issued moons. None are really suitable for hiding out.
Arnold suggested to mess with the terminal to see if we could get it to route us somewhere else.
When Kate inspected it though she said doing that would trigger some form of protocol which would send us flying into space...
I fear then we might have discovered what happens if we don't make quota.
If true the company is much worse than we initially thought.

However Berry actually made a pretty good remark, he asked if we could take one of the ships back on Repress.
We had enough credits to go there soo.. now were here.
None of the ships were really usuable except for this one older model.
Kate said she can patch it up given enough time, it's missing a few components but we might be able to get those during the next quota.
There is hope.

Text ⁠
-16th of July 2349-
I have unfortunate news.
Yesterday we lost Berry..

We went to Rend and everyone headed out to look for bolts, screws, metal plating, toy robots for wiring we could use on the new ship.
Of course we left Berry in the ship, he was still sick but starting to recover.
He was great at communicating during ship duty, even though he felt like shit he was still able to crack a few jokes over the walkie.
I remember him asking *What's the best animal to bring to the battlefield... DUCK!!* its so stupid its funny.
We knew something was up when it went silent though.
And sure enough when we headed back I faintly saw him roam around in the snow covered in red goop wearing a comedy mask, like he was possessed.
None of us had the strength to put him down if he was still in there so we just.. left.
I'll miss him.

Kate and Arnold are now properly together, happy for them. They fit each other well.
Stress is starting to take me though.. I feel a constant pressure as we're racing against the clock.
Makes me feel dizzy at times.

The ship is almost ready luckily. Good thing because our quota is reaching scarily high.
Especially with Berry gone we're not even sure if we'll make it past the next one.
We just need a control panel. None of us have seen one just yet but tomorrow we're making a visit to Titan, hopefully we'll find one there.
We have already planned out a place to escape to.
There's this city on a moon far from this region. 495-Risk. Fitting name I suppose.
Once we get there we'll be safe. Hopefully.
I'll write again when we return for hopefully our final visit.

Transcript security recording - Day 16

S. Dent: I think that’s it. I think we’ve got it. This will be perfect when it’s merged with the main compound.
C. Darter: Yeah.. that’s great.
S. Dent: Is something wrong? I thought you’d be celebrating.
C. Darter: I don’t think we’re doing the right thing.
S. Dent: How so? We’re helping people. If not for the Triton Empire we’re saving people’s lives with this.
S. Dent: Are we not? Cavil?
C. Darter: They uh.. You aren’t allowed to know but it’s likely not for the purpose you’ve been led to believe.
S. Dent: What do you mean? This is medicine, it will protect people.
C. Darter: Yes but. Not the people you might think.
S. Dent: Well.. Go on.
C. Darter: This is part of Project Mycete. A project where they’re attempting to make enhanced soldiers by stuffing them with experimental drugs.
S. Dent: What.
C. Darter: And.. not only that but out there people are being slaughtered, tortured and murdered in pursuit of people fit for the procedure.
S. Dent: WHAT.
S. Dent: All this time. I have been working for a lie. Harming these poor creatures. Just so we have a small step up in this conquest??.
C. Darter: .. Basically.
S. Dent: Why didn’t you tell me?
C. Darter: I mean, they will likely have me repurposed when they discover I have now leaked this information.. It’s more of an execution than a repurpose.
S. Dent: Right. So. What now?. Do we leave? Do we burn it all? Tell me.
C. Darter: I need time to think. I don’t want to hand Sol this research. We’ll talk about this tomorrow. Pretend like none of this happened.
S. Dent: Yeah. Okay. Simple. I’ll just simply pretend like I haven’t spent the past two and half weeks risking my life for a lie.
C. Darter: I mean it.
—----------------------- 16:13 - Office

J. Charter: Sarah? Are you okay?
S. Dent: I’m fine.
J. Charter: The tears running down your face say otherwise. Did something happen?
S. Dent: I would prefer not to talk about it.
J. Charter: Something personal?
S. Dent: Yea.
J. Charter: I see.. If something is up you can talk to me about it, it’s okay.
S. Dent: Wouldn’t want it to be a detriment to the mission would you.
J. Charter: What?
S. Dent: No I mean. I’m sorry. I don’t know where that came from. It’s just hard. I’m not sure if I can take much more of it.
J. Charter: It’s okay, I get it.
S. Dent: Did Cavil send you?
J. Charter: No he didn’t.
S. Dent: What made you come here?
J. Charter: Well you’ve seemed a bit down today. It’s important that everyone on this crew feels okay. And I also care.. about.. you. I mean..
S. Dent: Thank you, I really appreciate it. There’s just.. Maybe I miss home and it’s wearing me down.
J. Charter: That makes sense. I can’t say I don’t miss it back there. Sooner or later we’ll be back. We just have to complete our mission. We’ll be okay.
S. Dent: Yeah. Thank you, really.

Text ⁠
Transcript security recording - Day 17 
—----------------------- 18:56 - Maintenance tunnel

C. Darter: Hopefully nobody can hear us down here.
S. Dent: Hope so too. Have you got an idea?
C. Darter: I have a plan. It will be hairy.
S. Dent: Alright. Can’t be worse than whatever they’re doing out there.
C. Darter: It’s a two part plan. We have to destroy the autopilot. And manually route it somewhere else so they won’t be able to find it. I wrote the coordinates on this note. Send this ship here.
S. Dent: Uhm. Okay. What will you do?
C. Darter: I’ll make sure they won’t be able to track the ship anymore and prepare the escape pod.
S. Dent: What about Julian? We tell him right?
C. Darter: It’s better if we don’t. He’s loyal to the Triton Empire. I don’t trust him to betray that.
S. Dent: Well we can’t just leave him. Maybe he’ll listen to me.
C. Darter: It’d be best not to try. He might sound the alarm.
S. Dent: I won’t leave him.
C. Darter: If you can convince him to join us in the escape pod he can come with. But only after you’ve done your part.
S. Dent: Right, If this is another lie I’ll kill you.
C. Darter: I promise.
S. Dent: When do we start?
C. Darter: 22:00. I’ll have the escape pod ready by 23:30. Be there.
S. Dent: Okay.
C. Darter: I have some digging to do. Good luck.
S. Dent: You too.

—----------------------- 22:24 - Security office

J. Charter: The fuck.

—----------------------- 22:38 - Cockpit

J. Charter: Who’s there? Sarah?
S. Dent: Julian?
J. Charter: What are you doing? Did you mess with the autopilot?
S. Dent: I can explain.
J. Charter: Is this an order? Why are you doing this?
S. Dent: This is not right.
J. Charter: What do you mean?.
S. Dent: This whole project is wrong. We’re not helping anyone with this. It won’t be for medicine. We’re developing weapons.
J. Charter: I know. This is a military operation, as was stated in my briefing.
S. Dent: You knew? This whole time? They’re torturing people. Just so they can experiment on the survivors with this. You’re okay with that?
J. Charter: People suffer either way. Whether we complete this mission or not. You know that. We could be part of something great.
S. Dent: If we are building a future like this.. I want none of it.
J. Charter: You’re a traitor.
S. Dent: Please, think about it. We can escape this. Leave it behind. Knowing we won’t have innocent blood on our hands.
J. Charter: I trusted you, Cavil trusted you. Why would you sabotage the mission. We were going home. We were..
S. Dent: Cavil is preparing the escape pod. Please just come with me.
J. Charter: You all Lied to me. You betrayed me.
S. Dent: Please Julian, they are evil.
J. Charter: Why.
S. Dent: Julian, please. Calm down, Lower your weapon and join me. We’ll be okay.
S. Dent: Please calm down, Julian, please. Juli-.
J. Charter: I.. I’m sorry.

—----------------------- 23:13 - Central hallway

J. Charter: I’m sorry Sarah. I love you.

—----------------------- 23:16 - Cargo bay

J. Charter: I’m sorry.

lore.title: Thalasso
lore.intro: Deep below the ocean waves lies a fortune long forgotten. The temple of Thalasso housed many of people we would now call ancient. They had their lifestyle, their rituals.. ones which are now deemed unnatural.

secs.html:
This map is hidden somewhere inside the temple of Thalasso. After interacting with it a strange audio will play. After that Utril will be unlocked for you.

Image & Text ⁠
Past the floating island, through two ravines they light the way, a guide through the darkness of Utril.

Image & Text ⁠
I am nearing my day of birth yet again. It will be the twenty first.
While to most it would seem a day of happiness.\nI look at it the opposite.
This year I have graduated for a course I was happy to start.
But time has shown that it might not be within my interest in this form.
Therefor I feel a part of life was wasted. I have yet to understand what I truly want to do with the years that remain.
I feel like a rock in a river. With life flowing around me. Unmoved. Waiting for change. Change that might never come if I stay this way.

Image & Text ⁠
During my time in this realm of mortality I have made friends of many. Though very few have stuck with me past my time of being around them.
Grateful I am to those who remain. Those whom I can consider close.
True friends.
However I fear that the friends I have made in the past year become one with those who no longer seek contact with me. The thought haunts me daily. I fear that I might end up alone once more.
I fear the void we call loneliness.
Often I sit down, just me and my thoughts. No one to join my pondering. To fill up the void.

Image & Text ⁠
It was a while ago when I first felt it. I felt it for a friends. But for the three years I was around. I was too scared to say something. And now we talk no longer.
I often wonder what life would be had I been more courageous.
But now I have felt it once more.
Someone else. Another friend.
But it is different this time. While I send it from my side. I know I will never receive it.
While to some it is a blessing. To me it is a curse. I feel the weight on my chest whenever I mention it.
I feel like I am driving them away whenever I send it.
I am lost.
And I do not know the way.

Image & Text ⁠
My existence, my being, my mortality are comming thougts which cycle through my head more often than not.
My future, my past, my heart's desires. And the choices made which brought me here. Could I have done something different I wonder. Could I have been happy.

I offered to have my heart cut out. In the ceremony of this rotation.
I hope to be placed among the others. I hope to be happy. I hope to be unalone.
I hope for my soul to be at peace within it. And may I be found.
I ask, please, take care of me.

lore.title: Trite
lore.intro: Once a thriving moon clustered with many cities, Trite was the place to be. However deep into the war there was a catastrophic attack, leaving the cities in ash. Many had fled and left their stuff behind. But it is still riddled with remants of war.

secs.h: Major Story Spoilers: Decision or Failure Aftermath
secs.html:
If players decided to not overload and blow up ResearcherxB or otherwise did not successfully locate the ship, players will receive a distress signal that tells them their time is up and that ResearcherxB will crash onto Trite. ResearcherxB will become inaccessible on that save file past this point. The next time players land on Trite, they will receive a signal, usually in the afternoon, that the ship is about to crash. The ship will then crash onto Trite's exterior in roughly another hour of in-game time.

If players land on Trite in the future on that save file, it will have been completely overrun by white mold. Several Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior immediately upon landing and large portions of the interior will be covered in growth, obscuring vision.

Trite was a thriving and powerful moon in the region under the rule of the Emperor. However, the Triton military's destruction of Calist was the catalyst for a war that eventually lead to Trite being bombarded and decimated by opposing dominions.

Radio message 3 continues the story of the Across the Stars radio host, unlocking Filitrios when logged. They cover the fall of Trite and recommed to head to Demetrica.

lore.title: Utril
lore.intro: Utril, home of the Spore Lizards, infested with arachnids. This moon is home to a research lab where they dabbled into the cloning of wildlife. To better harvest the goodies from the Spore Lizards. Every science has its risks however.

secs.html: If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Utril's exterior. If players land on Utril in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

secs.h: Harrington's Crash Log & Harrington's Research Logs
secs.html: Harrington's Crash Log and Harrington's research can spawn randomly as scrap within the interior and continue the story of Professor Harrington, a scientist previously researching on Cosmocos before its split and teleportation. After leaving the split chunk of Cosmocos that came to be known as Desolation, Harrington crash landed on either an undisclosed location or Utril itself and aided in major breakthroughs in the cloning process after recovering. Once the military got involved, Professor Harrington sabotaged the project by removing any mention or research of a chemical that prevents clones from dying of cancer in about a month.

Text ⁠
The past few weeks have been difficult.
My memory hasn't been the same since the crash.
I do not recall much from before.
All that remains is some faint visions of self healing flesh, independently growing eyes and a bright flash before panic ensued.
4 of us fled to one of ships and escaped the scene.
I don't know what happened to the other two teams who were present at the time.
I have now come to know that the entirety of Cosmocos vanished. And what we were standing on was merely a severed chunk of it.

Nobody has dared to return. We called it Desolation.
I'll attach the coordinates to this log for anyone brave enough to have a look for themselves.
After my recovery I might be able to help the people out over here.
I've heard some interesting projects being discussed.

Professor Harrington, over and out.

Text ⁠
It's been a while now since my arrival at this facility.
I've been closely paying attention to the projects here.
I was told that moon is THE home of the Lacerta-glomerorum.
Or.. spore lizards in the common tongue.
This is where they are most frequently hunted.
However, in the labs they seem to be working on cloning technology.
The cloning of creatures to be more specific.
I feel it's right up my alley.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Text ⁠
I wanted to give an update to my time here.
The cloning process is very complex but the technology is easy to produce.
When they explained to me the current state of the project I was told that they had figured out how to grow a spore lizard from practically nothing to a fully functioning adult in the matter of days.
However there was one fatal flaw.
Due to GYN-H chemicals used in the process of speeding up the development of the creature, a unique form of cancer would grow in the brain which, after about a month would kill it.
But I think I came up with a solution, LYN-H is a very similar chemical to GYN-H, It's only down one component.
I've theorised this could be the required change.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Text ⁠
Not weeks ago we had a big breakthrough with one of my theories.
Now yesterday our front door was broken though.
After having celebrated our victory in the cloning of spore lizards we weren't expecting to see the military show up to investigate our lab.
But after learning about our success in the cloning department, we had a.. less than peaceful discussion as they had brought it to their higher ranks who now demand to use it to clone.. people.. for the war of course.
This leaves us with a choice, we either give them an unlimited army.. or we destroy all our progress.

I have to take my leave.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

Text ⁠
This will be my last day here, after today, I will be fleeing once more.
But to someplace safe this time.
We had come to the decision that the decades of research was simply too valuable to destroy.
So we have handed them the tools, the research and they will likely proceed with making their own soldier in labs.
The prospect of that is horrifying.
Or.. well
It would have been had I not removed any mention of LYN-H, the one thing that prevents clones from dying shortly after being created.
The armies they grow will all drop dead within a month after being created.
Time to find a brighter horizon.
Professor Harrington, over.. and out.

Somewhere on moon's exterior there's a hidden map on the ground that you can interact with. When you proceed to do so a strange audio will play. After that Cubatres will be unlocked for you.

This is professor Harrington and I have found myself to be on Utril.
The days may be darker than the nights yet it has a strange sense of beauty.
It is not a place I ever expected to visit.
The wildlife is unlike the usual, not very diverse.
Generally consistent of spore lizards and arachnids.
It was surprising to learn that it wasn't the spiders that were the aggressive ones here.
They were much more keen on posing for a picture.
Either way,
I'm needed back in the labs.
Professor Harrington, over and out.

While there are no loggable items or data terminals found on Xenphir, the Droop has a unique Bestiary Entry that provides context for what happened to this moon.

Droop ⁠
DROOP

Sigurd's danger level: uhhhh I dnot know but thsi sou nds horrifyign

Scientific name: Vorictus-detoma

The Vorictus-detoma, garnered the name “Droop” due to its drooping appearance. Its arms, legs and neck are exceptionally long, likely due to the body deformation which happens in the process of a Droop’s creation.

The Droop is not officially classified as a non-human creature, while it no longer possesses the humanity it once did, it technically is still human. Only with the effects of prolonged exposure to V-Radiation.

V-Radiation is an incredibly rare phenomenon and has previously had very adverse and unexplainable effects on creatures and places, often leading to deformation and destruction. Sightings of V-Radiation were extremely rare up until the Grand war where it was occasionally used to cause mass destruction. However, even by supporters of the use of biological warfare, it was greatly frowned upon due to its cruel and otherworldly effects often rendering places uninhabitable.

While there have not been many encounters, the majority of the Droop were likely everyday civilians affected during the war.
Direct exposure to gamma or beta rays of V-Radiation vaporises the average unprotected human, leaving behind what can only be described as a shadow or a memory where they once were. It is not certain what exactly it is that they leave behind but it is thought to no longer be alive. However there have been rumors of these shadows stalking or moving in the dark.
When exposed to alpha rays of V-Radiation you won’t immediately notice any harmful effects aside from a slight headache or brief dizziness. But from the moment of exposure you have been infected with a unique type of radiation sickness. While it doesn’t break your DNA, it does change it which only becomes noticeable after a few days. Skin might start feeling heavy and organs might move around during a very painful process. If the infected is still alive 13 days past the first exposure, changes start happening to the brain, often noting highly irregular brainwaves. From this point onwards it is only a husk of its former self. While it is on a technical level not death, this is what we consider the moment of death. The person is unrecoverable and the body is deformed to an unrecognisable level where the skin and muscles resemble a droopy obsidian.

There has not been any research from this point onwards.

lore.title: Infected Bunker Spider
lore.intro: The Infected Bunker Spider is a hostile entity and variant of the Bunker Spider added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. It is a large white spider with black markings and two spikes of white mold on its body.

secs.html:
The Infected Bunker Spider can additionally spawn immediately on the exterior of one or several moons depending on if players let ResearcherxB crash or decide to overload it. If players let it crash onto Trite, several Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day every time players land on Trite afterward on that save file.

If players instead decided to overload the ship, debris from the ship can fall onto the exteriors of several moons. A couple or few Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior of the moon every time players land on it afterward on that save file. The moons currently known to have a chance for debris to fall onto their exteriors are Carnate, Core, Crowd, Dune, Glace, Heap, Hyve, Infernis, Junic, Selector, and Utril.
